name: Oshikake Dousei ☆ Nikushokukei no Kare ni Taberarechau Every Day
original_name: 押し掛け同棲☆ 肉食系のカレに食べられちゃうEvery day
source:
My name is Yanada Hina.
This year I entered university as a first year student.
Free from studying for tests I'm having fun with group activities, and I finally got the boyfriend that my heart desired.

I want to get along better with my boyfriend.
So I thought up a plan!!
My boyfriend lives alone, so it's a big plan to become an uninvited visitor in his house!

Definitely, DEFINITELY, we'll be able to spend some lovey-dovey time together.
Good Luck Me...!!

***

I can't turn off my carnivore boyfriend's switch!
In his bedroom, the kitchen, the bathroom...
In a fitting room, a cafe, sometimes on the other side of the door my friends are at...

I want to be spoiled by him, teased by him, and to spend sweet time with him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0085302/]Digiket[/url]]
